metrics.title: What the AI-first model buys you

items.label: Lower build cost
items.detail: Same senior team, half the billable hours, because the boilerplate is not hand-written.

items.label: Faster delivery
items.detail: Close to half on form-heavy systems; research-heavy or third-party-bound work less so. Discovery on Monday, a running prototype the same sprint.

items.label: UI/UX from the idea
items.detail: Product designers sit in from the first call. You approve screens before we write the backend.

items.label: Code you own
items.detail: Your repos, your cloud accounts, your CI. No lock-in, no black boxes, no rented platform.

metrics.footnote: Cost and time figures compare our delivery against the same scope quoted on a traditional hourly outsourcing model. We show you the arithmetic during discovery.

aiFirst.title: Most agencies added AI to the pitch deck. We rebuilt the delivery line around it.
aiFirst.subtitle: AI-first is an operating model, not a tool subscription. Here is what it actually changes.

items.title: AI writes the first draft. Seniors write the decisions.
items.body: Scaffolding, CRUD, test suites, migrations, API clients and docs are generated and then reviewed line by line. Architecture, data modelling, security and trade-offs stay human — those are the parts that cost you money when they are wrong.

items.title: Every PR passes an automated review before a human sees it.
items.body: Lint, types, tests, dependency and security scans, plus an AI reviewer tuned to your codebase conventions. Human review starts where the machine stops, not at formatting nits.

items.title: Specs stay executable.
items.body: Requirements live next to the code as tests and typed contracts. When the spec changes, the failing test tells you what broke — instead of a Slack thread three weeks later.

items.title: We build AI into your product too.
items.body: RAG over your own data, agent workflows, LLM evaluation harnesses. We run these in our own products, so you get the failure modes we already paid for.

design.title: You should see the product before you fund it.
design.body: Most outsourcing starts with a requirements document and ends with a surprise. We start with screens. Product designers join the very first call, turn your idea into a clickable prototype, and iterate with you until the flow is right — before a single backend endpoint exists. Cheapest time to change your mind is now.

steps.title: Idea session
steps.body: You describe the problem. We map the users, the jobs and the money path on one board.

steps.title: Clickable prototype
steps.body: Real screens, real flows, no lorem ipsum. Walk it like the finished product and tell us what is wrong.

steps.title: Design system
steps.body: Once the flow is approved, screens become tokens and components — so the built product matches the prototype.

steps.title: Build against the design
steps.body: Engineers implement approved screens. No redesign-mid-sprint, no 'it looked different in Figma'.

items.title: Discovery
items.body: One 30-minute call plus a short written brief. We come back with scope, risks, timeline and a fixed number.

items.title: Prototype
items.body: Clickable UI and a technical spike on whatever is riskiest. You approve before the main build is funded.

items.title: Build
items.body: Two-week sprints, a demo you can click at the end of each one, and a shared board you can read any day.

items.title: Handover or run
items.body: We hand over docs, runbooks and a trained team — or stay on to operate it. Your call, not a contract term.

engagement.title: Pick the risk you want to carry
engagement.subtitle: Two ways to work with us — one safe path that funds cash flow, one bet we take alongside you on the outcome. We will tell you which one fits.

items.name: Fixed scope
items.best: Companies with a budget and a clear scope
items.body: We quote a number and a date, paid by milestone. Once it ships, our duty ends beyond the contracted warranty. Overrun is our problem, not yours.

items.name: Fixed fee plus revenue share
items.body: A low fixed fee plus a share of revenue. We stay long-term, our upside tied to your business results — with lifetime warranty and proactive care.

items.q: If AI writes the code, why do I need you?
items.a: Because AI writes plausible code, not correct systems. It will happily generate an auth flow with a hole in it. Our value is the senior review, the architecture and the accountability — AI just removes the typing.

items.q: Who owns the code and the IP?
items.a: You do, from the first commit. We work in your repositories and your cloud accounts. There is no Tedo platform you have to keep paying for.

items.q: How is 50% cheaper not just 50% worse?
items.a: The saving comes from hours not spent hand-writing boilerplate, not from junior engineers or from cutting review. The same seniors review every line. Ask us to walk through a real PR during discovery.

items.q: What if the team is not a fit?
items.a: Two-week trial on dedicated teams, and you can replace anyone without a penalty. If we are the wrong fit for your problem, we will say so on the first call.

items.q: Do you sign NDAs and handle sensitive data?
items.a: Yes. NDA before discovery if you want one. For regulated work we scope data handling, access control and audit logging explicitly — and we will tell you when a requirement is outside what we should take on.
